title: Second prophecy begun
english: We take up Balaam’s [[second prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 23:11-24]]. Balak is stunned to hear blessings instead of curses.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XV; second oracle CLOSEOUT.

title: God is not a man that he should lie
english: [[God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should change >> Bible:Numbers 23:19]]. He has spoken, and he will do.

title: Blessing that cannot be reversed
english: [[He has blessed, and I will not reverse it >> Bible:Numbers 23:20]]. No spell against Jacob; the Lord his God is with him. Glory to Christ forever. Amen.
